name: Sodalis
tagline: The companion animal record, kept with institutional precision.
positioning: Sodalis unifies your pet's health history, care schedule, and provider communications into a single verified profile you actually control.

hero.h1: Every detail of your pet's care, formally documented.
hero.sub: Sodalis maintains a verified, chronological record of vaccinations, medications, weight, and vet correspondence — so nothing is lost between appointments, clinics, or households.

features.title: The Unified Ledger
features.description: Consolidate vaccine certificates, prescriptions, and diagnostic results into one authoritative timeline instead of a folder of photographed paperwork.

features.title: Verified Provenance
features.description: Each record is tagged with its issuing clinic and date, producing a defensible history you can hand to any new veterinarian in seconds.

features.title: Care Cadence
features.description: Automated reminders for boosters, flea and tick renewals, and dosage windows — scheduled to your pet's actual protocol, not a generic calendar.

features.title: Household Access
features.description: Grant sitters, family members, or co-owners scoped, time-limited access to the exact records they require and nothing more.

features.title: Portable Export
features.description: Generate a clinic-ready PDF summary or a boarding-facility intake sheet with one action, formatted to industry expectations.

features.title: Longitudinal Trends
features.description: Track weight, appetite notes, and medication adherence over years to surface patterns worth raising with your veterinarian.

testimonials.quote: When we relocated across state lines, our new clinic accepted the Sodalis export without a single follow-up request. It replaced a shoebox of receipts and three panicked phone calls.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Halloran

testimonials.quote: As a foster coordinator I manage records for a dozen animals at once. The scoped household access alone justified the subscription within the first week.
testimonials.name: Devon Achebe

testimonials.quote: My vet complimented the medication timeline. That has genuinely never happened with any spreadsheet I built myself.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

For multi-pet homes that need shared, scoped access.

homepage.footerBlurb: Sodalis is the system of record for the animals you are responsible for. Precise, portable, and entirely yours.
